I believe most of the instructors of this course have no working experience outside Bilkent and hence has no idea what actually is expected of employees. The example reports and presentations used in the course are inadequate and laughable when evaluated in a professional setting as they were sloppily prepared.
Coming to the concept of an "engineering solution", any improvement of the system is an engineering solution. It does not have to be "technical", just has to have an objective impact that can be measured. "If I can think of it, it is not an engineering solution" as was stated by our instructor is simply ignorant.
I personally would have prefered if the aim of the course was to actually train students in presentation and report writing more than creating work that has to fit the cookie-cutter prepared years ago by the department. And if the aim actually shifts to presentation and report writing, I believe instructors should get trained in these topics to be able to teach what is wanted in the professional world. Simply saying "do not put your hands in your pockets" is not helping anyone with their presentations.
